outputs.title: 코어 과부하
outputs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: game animation storyboard sheet for production review, not a poster.
Create ONE polished landscape storyboard sheet with exactly SIX framed cinematic panels in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, read left to right, top row then bottom row. White/light gray page, generous white gutters. A compact title at top and legible clean sans-serif shot-number and timestamp strips above each panel. Draw dynamic cinematic staging, readable mechanical silhouette, stylized game concept painting with confident ink contour and restrained painterly shading. Within each panel draw small cyan arrows ONLY as camera movement annotation and small amber arrows for tank/part movement.
Input image 1 is CHARACTER IDENTITY reference: the boss is the toy-like squat silver/lavender rounded MAMMOTH TANK with brown paired caterpillar treads, two large forward cannons, smaller side sponsons and a circular bright magenta-red central front core. Keep this unmistakable silhouette, proportion and colors across all six shots. This is a mechanical tank, NOT an elephant or organic mammoth. Input image 2 is ARENA/PLAYER reference: dark violet neon highway, long cyan road strips and amber-black side barriers, tiny cobalt-blue/purple robot player with cyan booster trail. Match this world; no humans. Maintain the player as a small readable silhouette and keep the tank much larger. No extra tanks.
Constraints: six distinct sequential states, diagrams must correspond to physically coherent continuous action. No HUD or healthbar, no unreadable paragraphs, no watermarks. Keep Korean text to the requested short title/shot labels only. Clearly separate cyan camera arrows from actual visual effects. Depict sparks, stylized volumetric smoke, rim light, mechanical debris; no gore. Concept art, not a literal engine screenshot.
Primary request: Plan A, a dramatic escalating CORE OVERLOAD ending in one decisive explosion and a rising ejected turret.
Text (verbatim): title "A · 코어 과부하"; numbered shot labels "01 최후의 타격 0.00s", "02 코어 클로즈업 0.18s", "03 연쇄 파손 0.85s", "04 포탑 분리 1.85s", "05 최종 폭발 2.65s", "06 추격 종료 4.60s".
Panel 1: high three-quarter gameplay-like overhead shot, tank ahead, tiny blue player below. Final hit at the central magenta core with a sharp small white spark; motion about to stop.
Panel 2: continuous push-in, low three-quarter FRONT view, twin cannons framing an intensely glowing red-white circular core. Armor seams warm orange, engine vents first release smoke. Cyan arrow indicates dolly inward. The tank is still structurally recognizable, not exploding yet.
Panel 3: camera makes a controlled 25-degree arc around front-right side without crossing the action axis. A side sponson tears free and a missile pod cracks; only 3 localized orange mini-explosions. Sparks trail BACKWARD along the moving road. Cyan arc arrow and separate amber part arrows.
Panel 4: a LOW 3/4 shot with upward camera tilt, turret beginning to rise vertically off the hull by 1-2m, internal hot light visible. Frame the turret and tank base, no huge fireball yet, road motion streaks.
Panel 5: camera has rapidly pulled back enough to see a stylized orange-white fireball around hull, an elliptical ground shockwave ring, 6-8 readable chunky debris and the turret rising above the blast. This is the largest beat. Cyan outward dolly arrow; preserve player silhouette at edge; no solid all-white screen.
Panel 6: high quarter-view pulling back to original gameplay composition, player in foreground cyan booster trail, smoke and dim orange embers receding behind; road slowed. Readable aftermath, no victory typography.

Text (verbatim): title "B · 궤도 파손과 전복"; shot labels "01 궤도 파손 0.00s", "02 옆으로 미끄러짐 0.20s", "03 무게 중심 붕괴 1.00s", "04 차체 전복 2.00s", "05 충돌과 2차 폭발 2.85s", "06 잔해 통과 5.20s".
Panel 1: high three-quarter view, final damage detaches the tank's right track as one chunky brown tread pod; small sparks at attachment, clearly show intact left tread and falling right tread. Camera quick push-in indicated.
Panel 2: low camera moving sideways beside front quarter, tank yaws a modest 20 degrees and skids across a lane by 2m, right-front hull scrapes roadway. Long orange scrape sparks and 3 short road skid scratches; detached tread travels backward. Cyan lateral camera arrow.

Panel 5: wider frame at road contact impact: compact orange secondary fireball from the already overturned wreck plus a low ground dust ring, turret breaks away rolling backward, weight emphasized by compressed chassis and scrape trail. No jump launch or superhero floating tank.
Panel 6: returning high quarter-view, tiny blue player drives safely beyond the smoking sideways wreck, cyan highway perspective and gently receding black smoke. Show the action completed clearly.

This version feels eerie and restrained with fewer particles.
Text (verbatim): title "C · 마지막 코어 파열"; shot labels "01 마지막 피격 0.00s", "02 조명 순차 소등 0.18s", "03 거수의 침묵 0.80s", "04 마지막 심장박동 1.55s", "05 코어 파열 2.25s", "06 정지한 잔해 4.00s".
Panel 1: elevated front-quarter gameplay shot, last bright hit on tank core, player at foreground, motion halts briefly.
Panel 2: gentle dolly from high angle toward a medium-low frontal 3/4 shot. Cyan body strips shutting off from rear to front; the twin cannons lower subtly; only faint gray vent smoke. Core red fades toward black; no blast.
Panel 3: close FRONT 3/4 view of the black circular core between two lowered cannons; huge tank inert and still; sparse embers and road lights moving faintly. Most visually quiet panel, no camera movement arrow or electric flare.
Panel 4: exact same camera angle with a very slight 5-percent push-in, a thin magenta crack/line inside the existing round front core lights up and single ripple of red light, tank itself still. Do not split whole hull, no sword. Brief ominous heartbeat.
Panel 5: camera pulls wider, a controlled radial MAGENTA/WHITE core rupture and 6-8 slim electric bolts only around front tank core, 4 small armor pieces released, low lavender shockwave halo. Keep hull and brown treads visible as a damaged persistent wreck, no huge orange fireball and no full-screen whiteout.
Panel 6: camera blends back up to quarter-view. Powered-down silver tank remains whole enough to recognize, lowered twin guns and extinguished core, thin charcoal smoke drifting backward; small blue player moves ahead on cyan road. Quiet aftermath.
